origin.description: Return one style function that applies several styles. The right-most style is the inner one.
origin.details: Names are passed through make_ansi_style. The combined function applies the styles from right to left.

translation.description: Return one style function that applies several styles. The right-most style is the inner one.
translation.details: Names are passed through make_ansi_style. The combined function applies the styles from right to left.
translation.example:
from cli import col_red, combine_ansi_styles, options, style_bold
options(**{"cli.num_colors": 8})
alert = combine_ansi_styles(style_bold, col_red)
print(alert("Warning!"))
